attributes.residual: 12 words in two clusters. Cluster A (+0xb0,+0xb4,+0xc0,+0xfc,+0x108,+0x130,+0x138,+0x18c,+0x190) is 9 words that are now purely register-only, exactly the sigma the banked record predicted. Cluster B (+0x5d4,+0x63c,+0x69c) is three stores whose IMMEDIATE differs, not their registers: ours emits stw r0,0(r23) / stw r0,0(r20) / stw r0,0(r19) against retail's stw r0,1068(r31) / stw r0,1140(r31) / stw r0,1152(r31). Retail never materialised the hoisted p1140/p1152/p1032-style pointer locals and addresses those slots directly off the frame/base register with a displacement; our source hoists them into pointer variables. Cluster B is therefore SOURCE-REACHABLE (delete the pointer hoists in favour of direct indexed stores) and is the correct next lever, but it lies outside this lane's scope, which permitted only the one banked split.

attributes.verification: Full ninja green after the split with build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK, and matched held at 2623 functions -- the split is structure-only and invisible to score, precisely as the banked record warned. The sfx.c pin on fn_80094164 still replays to the retail bytes (57 atoms/fields -> EQUALS-RETAIL), proving the added local did not renumber the anonymous pool into a pinned sibling. RULE DECLINED, with reasons: (1) copy_register_fields is impossible because it requires the patched function to equal the retail bytes, and Cluster B's immediates cannot be reached by any register-field path; (2) a partial recolors/register_fields rule over Cluster A alone would leave the function non-exact, so it would gain ZERO matched percent; (3) it would nonetheless hash-freeze the raw body of InitEffects and every helper MWCC inlines into it, i.e. it would freeze exactly the source that must change to close Cluster B. Pinning here would spend a live source axis to buy nothing, so the sound decision is to bank the split and leave the function unruled.
